description: Stationnement vélo sécurisé en gare is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Le jeu de données précise le nombre de stationnements vélos sécurisés par gare et les objectifs d'installations demandés par le décret relatif aux stationnements sécurisé (loi LOM). 1075 gares SNCF Gares & Connexions sont concernées par ce décret. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Equipements et services en gares. Its keywords are vélo, stationnement. The portal shows 2025-04-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
